# External source provenance

Analysed from the public repository
`https://github.com/riteshnair/FreeMoe` at commit
`6c806c8e4c7cb6ae582dcda3c732f7046103976f` ("Add files via upload",
2026-10-28). The repository is MIT licensed and is not a GitHub fork.

The three source files were added in that commit on top of a near-identical
snapshot of this project. The workspace analysis branch is
`arena/f4ec845c-freemoe`; no runtime code was changed by this analysis.

## Derived copies in this directory

- `FreeMoe_Final_Solution_and_Build_Plan-1.md` — text extracted from the
  DOCX with Word paragraph styles mapped to Markdown headings.
- `FreeMoe_Model_Math_GGUF_Creation_and_Runtime_Spec.md` — verbatim copy.
- `implementation_pack/` — all text files extracted from the ZIP. The ZIP
  also embedded a byte-identical copy of the DOCX and a Markdown copy of the
  same plan; those binaries were not duplicated here.
